answer.reason: The verses tell of Felix hearing Paul's case and keeping him in custody, with enough story for a short line.

clauses.english: deferred the Jews' case against Paul and kept him in custody with liberty
clauses.quote: he deferred them, and said, When Lysias the chief captain shall come down, I will know the uttermost of your matter.

clauses.english: trembled as Paul reasoned of righteousness, temperance and judgment to come
clauses.quote: Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time

clauses.english: left Paul bound when Festus succeeded him, to please the Jews
clauses.quote: Felix, willing to shew the Jews a pleasure, left Paul bound.
